THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Fiesta Snack Box

Snack Box Series Ep. 10 — colorful post-lunch box with 365 Black Forest ham, Colby cheese, Gheelish tortilla dip chips, and mini sweet peppers. ~210 cal / 13g protein per box.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME12 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~210 cal | ~13g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 8 slices (~5 1/3 oz) 365 Black Forest deli ham — 2 slices per box, ~40 cal per portion
  • 4 Sargento Natural Colby-Jack cheese sticks — 1 stick cubed per box, ~80 cal per portion
  • 3 oz Gheelish Original tortilla dip chips — 0.75 oz per box, ~80 cal per portion
  • Mini sweet peppers (red / yellow / orange mix) — seeded and cut into age-appropriate strips to fill each box

You want a colorful after-school or post-lunch snack box for the kids and you're making 4 at once — 2 kids covered for 2 days. Ham plus Colby anchors ~13g protein, sweet peppers add fresh crunch, Gheelish tortilla dip chips bring the fun. 12 min flat, no cook.

Method

  1. 1.SET UP. Line up 4 divided snack boxes. Buluker pastel 4-compartment boxes shown — the same set featured on Favorites → Snack Box Essentials.
  2. 2.HAM. Fold or cut 2 slices of 365 Black Forest deli ham into one compartment of each box (~5 1/3 oz total across all 4 boxes).
  3. 3.COLBY CUBES. Cut each Sargento Natural Colby-Jack cheese stick into bite-size cubes and drop 1 stick's worth into the next compartment of each box.
  4. 4.SWEET PEPPERS. Seed and slice mini sweet peppers (red / yellow / orange) into age-appropriate strips. Fill one compartment of each box — the color story of the fiesta box.
  5. 5.TORTILLA DIP CHIPS. Weigh 0.75 oz Gheelish Original tortilla dip chips into the remaining compartment of each box. Portion just before serving if you want maximum crunch — the chip compartment stays driest that way.
  6. 6.SEAL + CHILL. Snap lids on and refrigerate. Serve within 2 days. Transport with an ice pack for lunchbox use.

Storage and reheating

Store: Refrigerate covered. Transport with an ice pack for lunchbox use.

Reheat: Don't — serve cold. That's the whole snack-box format.

Lasts: Best within 2 days. Peppers stay crunchy that long; chips are firmest if portioned just before serving.

Estimated nutrition

~210 cal | ~13g protein.

~210 cal / 13g protein per snack box, approximate. Component breakdown: 2 slices 365 Black Forest deli ham (~40 cal / ~5g protein) + 1 Colby cheese stick cubed (~80 cal / 6g protein) + 0.75 oz Gheelish Original tortilla dip chips (~80 cal / 1g protein) + mini sweet peppers to fill (~10 cal / <1g protein). Total: ~210 cal / ~13g protein. Marked estimated — values vary by deli meat brand, cheese brand, chip weight, and pepper fill. Confirm exact numbers off the labels of the specific brands you pick.

Brands I use

365 by Whole Foods Market
Black Forest Deli Ham (~5 1/3 oz pack of 8 slices; 2 slices ≈ 40 cal per portion).
Whole Foods house brand — kid-familiar ham without the additive stack you find on most sliced deli meats. 2 slices per box lands the ~40 cal / ~5g protein anchor from the meat layer.
Sargento
Natural Colby-Jack Cheese Snack Sticks (12-pack — ~80 cal / 6g protein per stick). 1 stick cubed per box.
Individually wrapped sticks that cube easily for kid-friendly finger-food. Colby-Jack is milder than sharp cheddar — an easier flavor for kids who don't love strong cheese. Same brand featured on Favorites → Snack Box Essentials.
Gheelish
Original Tortilla Dip Chips (gluten-free, made with ghee). 0.75 oz per box ≈ 80 cal.
The crunch layer. Ghee-based tortilla dip chip — gluten-free, no seed oils. 0.75 oz is enough to fill a compartment without turning the snack box into a chip bowl. See Favorites → Snack Box Essentials for the exact SKU + honest what-to-know.
Mini Sweet Peppers
Sunset / Bailey Farms / any brand of mini sweet peppers (red / yellow / orange mix). ~30 cal per full box of pepper strips.
The color story of the fiesta box + fresh crunch that balances the salty savory sides. Sweet peppers (not spicy) — kid-safe flavor. Any grocery brand works.
Buluker Snack Containers
Four-compartment pastel snack boxes (the exact set shown across the Snack Box Series).
Same 4-compartment containers used across every Snack Box Series entry. Cubed cheese, ham, peppers, and chips each get their own compartment so nothing goes soggy. See Favorites → Snack Box Essentials for the honest what-to-know.
